events.title: IUT Robotics Workshop 2026
events.venue: Islamic University of Technology (IUT) Robotics Labs
events.shortDesc: Intensive collaborative engineering workshop with IUT mentors on sensor tuning, motor drivers, and high-speed PID control.
events.description: Hosted in collaboration with engineering mentors at Islamic University of Technology (IUT). Participants build line-following algorithms from scratch, program microcontrollers, calibrate 16x infrared arrays, and test high-speed runs on a regulation collegiate track.

events.title: Robofest National Championship 2026
events.shortDesc: The premier competitive arena where MRC fields custom robots across autonomous line followers, robosoccer, and tech showcase.
events.description: Welcome to the ultimate proving ground of metal and software. Teams from colleges across the nation compete with high-velocity Line Following Robots (LFR), autonomous battlebots, and engineering innovation exhibitions. MRC members participate with our custom-engineered builds.

events.title: Thursday Hands-On Electronics & Firmware Lab
events.shortDesc: Weekly hands-on session for Manarat students: real components, zero boring theory, practical circuit wiring, and code.
events.description: Every Thursday after school, MRC runs hands-on sessions for curious and motivated students of Manarat. Students work closely with components, build practical skills, and understand how hardware is controlled through code.

projects.name: Apex-V3 Line Follower
projects.shortDesc: Custom PCB, 16x photodiode array, dual coreless 25,000 RPM motors, reaching 3.4 m/s on technical tracks.
projects.description: Engineered specifically for national collegiate LFR tournaments. Apex-V3 features an ultra-low center of gravity carbon fiber chassis, active suction downforce fan for high-speed corner grip, custom discrete MOSFET H-bridge driver, and STM32 microcontroller calculating PID loops at 2,000 Hz.

projects.name: Titan-9 Robosoccer Striker
projects.shortDesc: Holonomic triangular omni-drive system with solenoid-driven high velocity kicker and 360° IR ball sensor.
projects.description: Built for agility and aggression on the robosoccer pitch. Powered by 3 high-speed planetary gear motors angled at 120 degrees, allowing seamless omnidirectional translation without rotating. Equipped with an onboard 24V solenoid pulse kicker and Bluetooth low-latency telemetry.

projects.name: AeroScan Autonomous UAV
projects.shortDesc: Carbon-fiber quadcopter with optical flow positioning, sonar ground lock, and obstacle mapping.
projects.description: Designed for indoor autonomous exploration where GPS signals are unavailable. AeroScan utilizes an optical flow sensor on its ventral camera combined with a laser rangefinder to hold position down to single-centimeter accuracy, while a forward stereo camera detects pillars and walls.
projects.sensors: Optical Flow, LiDAR Lite v3, Ultrasonic Array

announcements.title: National LFR Championship 2026 — Track Specifications Published
announcements.content: The official rulebook and track layout for the 2026 National LFR Championship is now live. Line width is strictly 30mm white tape on non-reflective matte black PVC board. Bridge incline is 15 degrees. Check the events section to download the rule packet.
announcements.author: Executive Committee

announcements.title: Weekly Lab Hands-on Session: PID Tuning & Sensor Array Diagnostics
announcements.content: All club members are invited to Lab 402 this Thursday from 3:30 PM. We will be testing analog reflectance arrays with digital oscilloscopes and tuning proportional-derivative coefficients for high-speed stability.
